About Our Academy

Welcome to ALHAFIZ INTERNATIONAL ACADEMY

Nurturing Hearts & Minds with the Divine Words of Allah

ALHAFIZ INTERNATIONAL ACADEMY provides high-standard Quranic and Islamic education to students worldwide through Zoom, Google Meet and interactive digital whiteboards. Every lesson is one-to-one, so your child — or you — learns at a comfortable pace with the full attention of a certified tutor.

From a 4-year-old's very first Qaida lesson to advanced Ijazah and the Ten Qira'at, our structured curriculum follows the Wifaq-ul-Madaris tradition, with monthly progress reports for parents and certificates on completion.

Guidance for Parents & Students

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

What is ALHAFIZ INTERNATIONAL ACADEMY?

ALHAFIZ INTERNATIONAL ACADEMY is an online Quran academy offering 1-on-1 live classes in Noorani Qaida, Nazra, Tajweed, Hifz, Tafseer, Ijazah, Qira'at, Arabic and Islamic Studies for children (from age 4) and adults worldwide, led by Principal Hafiz Allah Ditta.

How do the online Quran classes take place?

Every class is 1-on-1 and live via Zoom or Google Meet. The tutor shares a high-definition digital Quran on screen with interactive pointer and pen tools, listens to your recitation and corrects it in real time. Each class lasts 30 minutes.

Is there a free trial?

Yes — a 3-day free trial with no credit card and no registration fee. Book through the form below and we confirm your class times on WhatsApp.

Can I choose a female Quran tutor?

Yes. Qaria Fatima heads our Female Department and teaches sisters and young girls. Simply select "Female Tutor" as your tutor preference in the trial form.

What age groups do you teach?

From 4-year-old children beginning Noorani Qaida, through school-age students, to adults and senior learners studying Tajweed, Hifz, Tafseer or Ijazah.

What payment methods do you accept?

After your free trial, monthly fees can be paid by international credit/debit card. If you prefer another method such as PayPal, Wise or bank transfer, please ask on WhatsApp and we will confirm what is available for your country.

What do I need for a class?

Any phone, tablet or computer with an internet connection and Zoom or Google Meet installed. No books are required — the digital Quran and Qaida are shared on screen.
